ApprovalRecord.description:
A person's approval of a plan (ADR 0054): an issue comment whose first line is
`Approved: plan <sha>` or `Approved: plan <sha> on <branch>` (ADR 0027), from a trusted
author only; or an approval given in Rubato, with its `approval_id` and no comment.

approval_id.description: The `rubato_approvals` row, for an approval given in Rubato.

branch.description: The branch the approval names; else the branch Rubato reads the plan from.

bundle_hash.description: The bundle an approval given in Rubato covers (the plan, its design note, its ADRs).

comment_id.description: The comment's id, for a comment approval.

sha.description:
The plan hash approved (checkboxes cleared, git blob sha). Absent when the comment names
none: the approval then shows as "version not named".

source.description: Absent for a comment, which is all an approval was before ADR 0054.

url.description: The comment's URL; empty for an approval given in Rubato.

oneOf.description:
An `Approved:` comment on the issue (ADR 0027). Counted only when posted before the
cutover, `RUBATO_COMMENT_APPROVALS_UNTIL`.
An approval given in Rubato, recorded in `rubato_approvals`.

ApprovalState.description: The newest counted approval of an issue's plan, and whether it is of the current version.

current_sha.description: The hash of the plan compared with, when there is one.

ApprovalVersion.description: How an approval relates to the plan Rubato holds now.

oneOf.description: The approved hash is the plan's hash now.
The plan changed after the approval (finding `ApprovalStale`).
The comment names no hash.
No plan file to compare with on that branch.

The approval names the plan as it is now, but the plan does not fit the map, so the
approval does not count (ADR 0029, finding `ApprovedWithoutFit`).

carries_approval.description: Whether the plan on the branch carries the approval record (ADR 0054).

sha.description: The plan's hash at the branch head.

ClientKind.description: What kind of client a companion is (ADR 0062). Every client has one owner and never approves.

oneOf.description: Sessions in the developer's tmux, input pasted into the pane.
No terminal: each turn is a `claude -p` child process the companion holds.

DraftFile.description: One file of a bundle, as it is in the worktree.

DraftRestore.description: Server → companion, in `LaunchCommand.draft`: a parked draft's newest settled revision.

files.description: Repository paths, relative, as `bundle_paths` gives them; the plan first.

fits.description: Whether the revision's plan fits the map.

plan_sha.description: The revision's plan hash, as an approval names it.

FleetEntry.description: One of the owner's launches, as `fleet_list` shows it: the same data the team already sees.

last_reply.description: The first line of the last reply, at most `limits::LAST_REPLY_CHARS`.

state.description: `None` is *unknown*: the session is not in its companion's snapshot.

oneOf.description: The same request is still being acted on.
It was claimed and never finished (the server stopped in between): never acted on again.

FleetResult.description: Server → companion: the answer to one `FleetRequest`.

message.description: Words for the agent: why, or what to do next.

message_id.description: For `message` and `stop`: the session message queued or sent.

GraphSourceInfo.description: One source as the server announces it to a companion.

content_hash.description:
`sha256:<hex>` over the snapshot's lines after the header. The same graph always has the
same hash, so an unchanged source is never fetched twice.

head_sha.description: The default-branch head a repo source was built at.

map_version.description: The map version a workspace source was built from.

truncated.description: A cap cut this source (`limits::GRAPH_*`). Not a failure; every answer from it says so.

GraphSources.description:
`ServerMessage::GraphSources`: every source the companion may hold, the whole list each time
(ADR 0086). The companion fetches what differs from its copy and deletes what the list no
longer names. Sent only to a companion that announced `capability::CONTEXT_GRAPH` and whose
owner may read the graph.

LaunchCommand.description:
Server → companion: start a session. Addressed to exactly one pairing; the companion refuses
any command whose `user` is not its paired user.

base_ref.description: Ref to branch from, such as `origin/main`.

draft.description:
The newest settled revision of the launcher's parked draft on this branch, for the
companion to write into a worktree this launch creates (ADR 0053, plan 122 §D5). Sent
only to a companion that announced `draft_restore`, and only while no plan is on the branch.

lead_launch_id.description: The lead that asked for this launch, for a worker a lead started.

map_version.description: Git sha of the map the server resolved pins against.

node_ids.description: Map node ids the issue is pinned to.

otel_resource.description: OTel resource attributes for the session (`rubato.repo`, `rubato.issue`, ...).

plan_path.description:
Where the plan lives in the worktree, by the map's rule (ADR 0009): what the companion
mirrors, with the bundle it names (ADR 0053). Absent from an older server.

planning.description: How the session plans (ADR 0053): `git` (default, today's flow) or `rubato`.

role.description:
A person's lead agent, or an ordinary worker (ADR 0072). Sent as `lead` only to a companion
that announced `fleet`.

session_id.description: Claude Code `--session-id` the companion must use, so `session_id → issue` is known up front.

user.description: GitHub login the command is addressed to.

LaunchRole.description: What a launch is for: an ordinary worker, or a person's lead agent (ADR 0072).

companion_silent_secs.description: A companion silent for longer than this fires `CompanionSilent`.

draft_max_bytes.description:
The largest plan bundle the companion mirrors (ADR 0053); a larger one is sent without
its files, refused as too large.

github_poll_interval_secs.description: How often the server polls GitHub for PRs, checks and decision comments per live issue.

plan_poll_interval_secs.description: How often the server looks for a plan file on a live branch.

room_agent_idle_secs.description: An agent not addressed for this long leaves the room (ADR 0057).

room_agent_turn_limit.description: Turns made by agents' messages in a row, with no person posting, before Rubato stops.

room_context_max_chars.description: The room context a turn carries, in characters (A9).

room_message_max_chars.description: The longest room message a person may post, in characters (ADR 0057).

session_log_max_chars.description:
The longest prompt or reply the companion forwards for the session log (ADR 0052); longer
text is cut and marked truncated.

session_message_max_chars.description: The longest session message the companion types (ADR 0051); longer ones are refused.

session_stale_secs.description: A *working* session with no hook event for longer than this renders *unknown*.

team_poll_interval_secs.description:
Reconcile interval: `tmux list-panes` and identity, every this many seconds. The name is
kept from the retired `tmux-ide team --json` poll (ADR 0070).

PlanStatus.description:
Where the plan of one launched session stands, as the server derives it (ADR 0071). The
companion keeps the newest per launch and answers `plan_status` from it.

approval.description:
The newest counted approval and whether it is of the current version; an approval whose
version is not `current` does not cover the plan as it is.

branch.description: The plan on the issue branch, when there is one.

draft.description: The newest settled revision of the launch's draft (ADR 0053).

review.description: The issue's newest counted design review.

PlanningMode.description:
How a launched session plans (ADR 0053): `git` is today's flow (commit, push, `Review:` and
`Approved:` comments); `rubato` drafts in Rubato and hands off at approval. The server sends
`rubato` only after the cutover and to a companion and skill that can carry it.

oneOf.description: Issue exists and is pinned to the map.
Session launched for the issue.
Session working, no plan file yet.
Plan file on the branch; affected nodes lit.
Session working after the plan.
Session blocked (hook) or a cap hit.
PR open, checks green.
Merged.
The signal is not flowing. Trust check first.

ReviewRecord.description:
A design review posted as an issue comment, first line `Review: <track> — <outcome>`
(ADR 0027). Only a trusted author's review is kept.

outcome.description: The rest of the first line, e.g. `passed after fixes`.

plan_sha.description: The plan version the review read, when its `Plan` section names one.

RoomKey.description: Which room: the query of `GET` `routes::ROOM`, and the key of a post.

oneOf.description: Planning, no plan on the branch: typed into the working session at idle.

Building, the plan on the branch: `claude -p --resume … --fork-session --permission-mode
plan` in the worktree, with no Rubato hooks.
Answer to `Hello`.

capabilities.description: What this server can take (`capability`). Absent from an older server.

last_seen_companion_seq.description: Last companion sequence the server has; the companion replays newer events.

oneOf.description: Text for one session the paired user launched (ADR 0051).

Where the plan of one session this companion launched stands (ADR 0071). Sent only to a
companion that announced `agent_mcp`.
The answer to one `FleetRequest` (ADR 0072). Sent only to a companion that announced `fleet`.

Every context graph source the companion may hold (ADR 0086). Sent only to a companion
that announced `context_graph` and whose owner may read the graph.
The connection will be closed. `code` is stable; `message` is for humans.

SessionMessage.description: Server → companion: something to type into one launched session.

launch_id.description: The launch the message is for. A `/clear` changes the session id, not the launch.

session_id.description: The launch's Claude Code session id as the server last knew it.

user.description: GitHub login of the session's paired user. The companion refuses any other.

oneOf.description: Text a person typed in Rubato for their own session.

A team member approved the session's plan in Rubato (ADR 0054): the companion types the
handoff command with the approval record as arguments (ADR 0055). Goes first.

url.description: Rubato's link to the approval, written into accepted ADRs.

oneOf.description:
The owner stops their own session (ADR 0062): the companion kills the running turn's
process group (headless) or the tmux session (interactive). Never queued, not held
behind an in-flight message, and not waiting for idle. Sent only to a companion that
announced `session_stop`.

A person addressed the owner's agent in the plan's room (ADR 0057, plan 122 §D8). The
companion types `text` into the working session while planning, or runs it in a
read-only fork while building; the reply comes back as `RoomReply`.

addressed_by.description: The person whose message made the turn.

fork_session_id.description: The fork's session id from an earlier turn: `--resume` it without `--fork-session`.

text.description:
The room since the agent's last turn, framed as quoted discussion with each author
(`room_turn_text`), cut to `Limits.room_context_max_chars`.

oneOf.description: No trustworthy signal. Never rendered as working.
